{{Top|leg}}
'''Waypoint Station Cresh''' was a [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] outpost on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], when the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]] was underway. A [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Republic trooper]]s including [[Geozel]], [[Gilroh]], and [[Ferdoin]] were tasked with escorting a supply convoy from Waypoint Station Cresh to [[Border assault post|Waypoint Station Morne]], but the convoy broke down and the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] decided to desert, prompting Morne's [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] [[Kahrin Wek]] to send forces to investigate.
